page.overview:
Who is Hayase?

Hayase was a bright individual, noted to have created the questions for the first stage of the Chūnin Exams.

Hayase has black hair that spikes outward and upward and tends to squint. His attire consists of a forehead protector and a grey jacket that has a hood and a pair of pants.

Hayase along with Ōkei - his academic rival - were inserted into the first phase of the Chūnin Exams so that other examinees could cheat off of them.
